# Will your cron job survive daylight saving?

> Paste a cron expression and timezone to see which runs a daylight-saving change skips or doubles, and how UTC-only schedulers drift. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
